entries.g: A company surveyed the monthly number of visitors to its online shop. Visitors grew steadily from January to March but fell for the first time in April. entries.ko: 한국어에는 몸의 일부를 이용한 관용 표현이 많다. 예를 들어 귀가 얇다는 실제로 귀의 두께가 얇다는 말이 아니라 남의 말에 잘 흔들린다는 뜻이다. 이런 표현은 글자 그대로 해석하면 뜻을 잘못 이해하기 쉽다. 그래서 관용 표현은 사용된 상황과 함께 익혀야 한다.
entries.g: Korean has many idiomatic expressions that use parts of the body. For example, the expression about thin ears does not literally mean the ears are thin, but that one is easily swayed by what others say. Interpreting such expressions word for word makes it easy to misunderstand them. So idioms should be learned together with the situations in which they are used.

read.true: The text advises learning idioms together with the situations in which they are used.
false: The text says Korean has very few idioms that use body parts.
The text says reading idioms word for word is the best way to understand them.
The text says the idiom about thin ears literally describes how thick the ears are.
